title: feat(nm2frm2smy): directed 2-step cyclic-frame transport along +e2 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: +e2 2-step, two-axis opposite, global tau. Every second hop fails: (0,2,0) forms at tick 1 and has no split at tau=1. Convention-stable. Its named-edge gates do pin the first-hop P matrices, but those never enter the verdict.
